name: Riviera Foodservice Equipment
description: Generic commercial kitchen equipment that ship with Riviera: placeholders at the sizes research note 14 gives, each a model fragment (IFC) with its IFC class and predefined type or kind, so the rule packs choose it. Generated from riviera_core::furnishings (ARC-FURN-001); regenerate with RIVIERA_REGEN_LIBRARIES=1.
author: Riviera contributors

Cooking/charbroiler_36_in_on_stand.ifc.name: Charbroiler 36 in, on stand
Cooking/charbroiler_36_in_on_stand.ifc.description: A 36 in underfired gas charbroiler 30 in deep and 16 in high on a 24 in stand (sizes from the 24–48 in range; no maker's sheet was read). Heavy duty (CMC 508.10: underfired broilers), with open flames.

Cooking/combi_oven_10_pan_on_stand.ifc.name: Combi oven, 10 pan on stand
Cooking/combi_oven_10_pan_on_stand.ifc.description: A 10-pan electric combi oven 42.2 × 41 × 41.9 in on a 24 in stand, with cold water and a drain to a floor sink. Light duty, but its steam surges at the door: UK guidance asks 600 mm of hood past its front.

Cooking/convection_oven_double_deck.ifc.name: Convection oven, double deck
Cooking/convection_oven_double_deck.ifc.description: Two full-size electric convection ovens stacked, 38 × 40 in and 70 in high on legs, about 11 kW a deck (judgement from the 36–44 in deep range). Light duty.

Cooking/fryer_40_lb_gas.ifc.name: Fryer, 40 lb gas
Cooking/fryer_40_lb_gas.ifc.description: A 40 lb gas floor fryer 15.1 × 30.25 in and 47.25 in to its flue, 90,000 Btu/h (Pitco 35C+S); its frying surface at about 36 in. Medium duty; NFPA 96 keeps it 16 in from an adjacent appliance's open flames, or behind a steel baffle.

Cooking/griddle_36_in_on_stand.ifc.name: Griddle 36 in, on stand
Cooking/griddle_36_in_on_stand.ifc.description: A 36 in countertop gas griddle 30 in deep and 16 in high on a 24 in equipment stand (sizes from the 24–48 in range; no maker's sheet was read). Medium duty.

Cooking/range_6_burner_with_oven_36_in.i.name: Range, 6-burner with oven 36 in
Cooking/range_6_burner_with_oven_36_in.i.description: A 36 in gas range, six open burners over a standard oven, 34 in deep and 58 in to the top of its backguard on 6 in legs, its burners at 36 in; 215,000 Btu/h (63 kW) at a ¾ in connection (Vulcan Endurance 36C). Medium duty (CMC 508.10); gas cookers have no IFC class, so it is an IfcElectricAppliance USERDEFINED with a gas port.

Cooking/tilting_braising_pan_30_gal.ifc.name: Tilting braising pan 30 gal
Cooking/tilting_braising_pan_30_gal.ifc.description: A 30 gal tilting skillet 38.5 × 39.75 in and 43.5 in high, 11.5 kW; it pours forward, so a floor sink goes in front of it. Light duty, but grease-producing: a Type I hood and suppression.

Fire safety/class_k_extinguisher.ifc.name: Class K extinguisher
Fire safety/class_k_extinguisher.ifc.description: A 6 L wet-chemical (Class K) extinguisher on a wall bracket, its top 5 ft up at most; within 30 ft of travel of commercial cooking (IFC 904.12.5).

Fire safety/fryer_baffle.ifc.name: Fryer baffle
Fire safety/fryer_baffle.ifc.description: A steel baffle 8 in high on a fryer's side, beside an appliance with open flames closer than 16 in (NFPA 96).

Prep and storage/shelving_24_x_48_in_4_t.name: Shelving 24 × 48 in, 4 tiers
Prep and storage/shelving_24_x_48_in_4_t.description: Wire shelving 48 × 24 in and 74 in high, four tiers, the lowest at least 6 in off the floor (Maricopa).

Prep and storage/work_table_30_x_48_in.i.name: Work table 30 × 48 in
Prep and storage/work_table_30_x_48_in.i.description: A stainless work table 48 × 30 in at 36 in with an undershelf.

Prep and storage/work_table_30_x_72_in.i.name: Work table 30 × 72 in
Prep and storage/work_table_30_x_72_in.i.description: A stainless work table 72 × 30 in at 36 in with an undershelf (sizes from the 36–96 in range).

Refrigeration/ice_machine_on_bin.ifc.name: Ice machine on bin
Refrigeration/ice_machine_on_bin.ifc.description: A 22 in ice-maker head 27 in deep and 30 in high (Hoshizaki KM-515) on a 30 × 34 in bin 44 in high; its water and drain through an air gap to a floor sink (NSF 12).

Refrigeration/reach_in_freezer_2_door.if.name: Reach-in freezer, 2-door
Refrigeration/reach_in_freezer_2_door.if.description: A two-door reach-in freezer the size of the refrigerator, 54.1 × 29.5 × 78.4 in, on 115 V.

Refrigeration/reach_in_refrigerator_2_do.name: Reach-in refrigerator, 2-door
Refrigeration/reach_in_refrigerator_2_do.description: A two-door reach-in refrigerator 54.1 × 29.5 × 78.4 in, about 49 ft³ (True T-49), on 115 V.

Refrigeration/refrigerated_prep_table_60.name: Refrigerated prep table 60 in
Refrigeration/refrigerated_prep_table_60.description: A 60 in refrigerated sandwich and salad prep table 30 in deep, its work top at 36 in under a pan rail (sizes from the 48–72 in range; no maker's sheet was read).

Sinks/floor_sink_12_x_12_in.ifc.name: Floor sink 12 × 12 in
Sinks/floor_sink_12_x_12_in.ifc.description: A 12 × 12 in floor sink under a grate, set in the floor at an indirect waste: its rim at least 1 in under the pipe ending over it (Food Code 5-202.13).

Sinks/hand_sink_wall_hung.ifc.name: Hand sink, wall-hung
Sinks/hand_sink_wall_hung.ifc.description: A wall-hung hand sink about 17 × 15 in, its rim at 34 in, with water at 85 °F or more (Food Code 5-202.12); within about 25 ft of each workstation, no door between (Maricopa), or 15 ft in the same room (CUPHD).

Sinks/mop_sink_24_x_24_in.ifc.name: Mop sink 24 × 24 in
Sinks/mop_sink_24_x_24_in.ifc.description: A floor-mounted mop sink 24 × 24 in with a 10 in curb (Food Code 5-203.13 asks one, or a curbed cleaning area).

Sinks/prep_sink_18_x_18_in_drainboard.if.name: Prep sink 18 × 18 in, drainboard
Sinks/prep_sink_18_x_18_in_drainboard.if.description: A one-compartment food prep sink 18 × 18 in with an 18 in drainboard, 39 × 24 in, its rim at 36 in; it drains indirectly to a floor sink (CUPHD).

Ware-washing/dish_machine_door_type.ifc.name: Dish machine, door type
Ware-washing/dish_machine_door_type.ifc.description: A door-type dish machine about 27 × 27 in and 59 in high closed (78.5 in open) with its booster heater: 7.1 kW booster and 5.4 kW tank on 208 V, hot water in, its drain to a floor sink (Hobart AM16). A high-temperature machine needs a Type II hood unless it is ventless.

Ware-washing/dish_table_clean_60_in.ifc.name: Dish table, clean 60 in
Ware-washing/dish_table_clean_60_in.ifc.description: A clean dish table 60 × 30 in at 34 in, as large as the soiled table.

Ware-washing/dish_table_soiled_60_in.ifc.name: Dish table, soiled 60 in
Ware-washing/dish_table_soiled_60_in.ifc.description: A soiled dish table 60 × 30 in at 34 in, sloping to the machine; the clean table should be at least as large.

Ware-washing/three_compartment_sink_18_x.name: Three-compartment sink 18 × 18 in
Ware-washing/three_compartment_sink_18_x.description: Three 18 × 18 in compartments (wash, rinse, sanitise; Food Code 4-301.12) between two 18 in drainboards, 90 × 24 in, its rim at 36 in; hot and cold water, and all three compartments drain indirectly to a floor sink (sizes derived from the compartments and drainboards).
